name: Fate's Descent
descriptionTemplate:
Obtain [Energy:Arg1] Aliemus. Recover [Heal:Arg2] HP, and recover an additional time for every 50 Aliemus currently possessed.
{Fate's Descent: Finale}
lore:
The ants scurry across the cathedral of creation, murmuring their fragile hypotheses. Pathetic. Amusing.
Every conviction shatters like bone. Memories and warmth? Merely shadows, smeared across the glass of the singularity.
When the universe drew its first, shuddering breath, there was nothing.
